    ∃ (Xtilde : Scheme) (πtilde : Xtilde ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
      (f : Xtilde ⟶ X),
      IsIntegral Xtilde ∧
      IsProjectiveVarietyOver K Xtilde πtilde ∧
      IsBirationalMorphismOver πtilde πX f := by
  sorry
